glossary.definition: A scheduled meeting between a patient and a doctor at a specific date and time
Time slots when a doctor is available to see patients
A specific time period when a doctor is unavailable despite regular availability
The minimum time period (24 hours) before an appointment during which cancellation is allowed
Documentation of a patient's visit including diagnosis, treatment, and notes
An individual registered in the system who can book appointments with doctors
A healthcare provider who offers medical services and accepts appointments
A specific area of medical practice (e.g., Cardiology, Pediatrics)
A 30-minute interval during which an appointment can be scheduled
An automated message sent to users about appointment confirmations, reminders, or cancellations
System administrator with privileges to manage doctors, view reports, and configure system settings
A record of all system actions and data modifications for security and compliance purposes
Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act - US law requiring protection of patient health information
A period of authenticated access to the system, automatically expiring after 30 minutes of inactivity
Multiple users attempting to book the same appointment slot simultaneously
Process of encoding data to prevent unauthorized access
User classification determining system access and permissions (Patient, Doctor, Admin)
